plugin.note: Scabarites count as kalphites, so the keris and keris partisan special effects apply. Slash defence is high (+90) - prefer stab or crush melee. Fire spells exploit a strong elemental weakness, and cannoning the Sophanem cavern level with Protect from Missiles is fastest.

requirements: Contact! (partial completion) to access Sophanem Dungeon
The Curse of Arrav (partial completion) for the Uzer Mastaba small scarabs
Lantern and tinderbox for the Sophanem Dungeon
mechanics: Locust riders come as level 98 rangers and level 106 crush-melee lancers; both count.
Scarab mages attack with magic on an unusual 15-tick speed, making prayer flicking straightforward.
Scarab swarms are poisonous, attack every tick, and give only 1 Slayer XP.
Scabarites are kalphites for keris purposes and carry a strong elemental weakness to fire spells.
A floor trap sits at the Sophanem Dungeon entrance.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill locust riders and scarab mages on the Sophanem cavern level with stab melee (keris partisan ideally) and Protect from Missiles.
requiredOrKeyItems: Keris partisan or another stab weapon
prayers: Protect from Missiles against the ranged locust riders
steps: Enter Sophanem Dungeon (Contact! partially completed) and mind the entrance floor trap.
Head to the cavern level with 27 locust riders and 18 scarab mages.
Keep Protect from Missiles up and kill with stab melee; slash bounces off their +90 slash defence.
Loot the 2,000 coin piles and noted bass from locust riders.
risks: The cavern is multicombat; several riders and mages can attack at once.

methods.label: Cavern cannoning
methods.summary: Place a dwarf multicannon on the Sophanem cavern level with Protect from Missiles and high-healing food for the fastest task.
steps: Set the cannon among the cavern-level locust riders and scarab mages.
Hold Protect from Missiles and eat through the scarab mage magic damage.
Reload and pick up the coin drops between volleys.
risks: Scarab mage magic damage bypasses Protect from Missiles - bring high-healing food.

methods.label: Guthan's sustain
methods.summary: Use Guthan's equipment against locust riders with Protect from Missiles for indefinitely long trips.
steps: Wear full Guthan's and attack locust riders on the cavern level.
Heal off the melee lancers while Protect from Missiles blocks the rangers.
Swap to a stab weapon when Guthan's healing is not needed.

methods.label: Maze prayer flick
methods.summary: Kill the two north-west scarab mages on the maze level, flicking Protect from Magic against their slow 15-tick attacks.
requiredOrKeyItems: Any strong stab or crush weapon
prayers: Protect from Magic, flicked on their 15-tick attack cycle
steps: Take the maze level and find the two scarab mages on the north-west side.
Flick Protect from Magic on their slow, highly accurate attacks.
Kill them alternately as they respawn.
risks: Mistimed flicks eat hits of up to 17 from the highly accurate mage attack.
